quests.title: Report the Experimental Data

dialogue.t: Phew. I've obtained valuable experimental data once more, and it's all thanks to you.
I have to finish my report before my mentor recovers. With any luck, he won't try to test it himself again. I'll stop him from sparring with monsters willy-nilly, even if it costs me my life.
Worse comes to worst, I'll take to the fight myself. Even if I fail, they'll at least put "Jami — he sacrificed himself for his research" on my tomb, eh? Hahaha...
I had a drink with a junior two days back. He said he wished to study the applications of the Long-Lasting Fayz Potion in different environments.
That way, ordinary people traveling outside will not be helpless when faced with beasts like Rishboland Tigers or Spinocrocodiles.
If this potion becomes widespread, my research topic will... gain some practical meaning, won't it? Once that time comes, I'll most certainly put your name into the acknowledgments section...
Hmm... This is less data than I expected, but it's enough for me to complete my research nonetheless.
I have to finish my report before my mentor recovers. With any luck, he won't try to test it himself again. I'll stop him from sparring with monsters willy-nilly, even if it costs me my life.
Worse comes to worst, I'll take to the fight myself. Even if I fail, they'll at least put "Jami — he sacrificed himself for his research" on my tomb, eh? Hahaha...

That way, ordinary people traveling outside will not be helpless when faced with beasts like Rishboland Tigers or Spinocrocodiles.
If this potion becomes widespread, my research topic will... gain some practical meaning, won't it? Heh. Guess I'll need to work harder still...

quests.description: The experiment is complete! Report the data on the long-lasting Fayz Potion to Jami.
